units: metres; glTF Y up, characters face +Z
regionRule: drop a triangle when all three of its vertices are in hidden regions

stockings.desc: knitted wool stockings, knee to ankle

breeches.desc: loose knee breeches gathered below the knee

shoes.desc: low leather shoes with a tongue and a ribbon tie

boots.desc: tall soldier's boots with a turned-down cuff

doublet.desc: fitted doublet with tabbed skirt, sleeves, shirt cuffs and buttons

collar_band.desc: plain white linen falling band collar

smock.desc: loose peasant smock to mid-thigh, long sleeves

bodice.desc: laced bodice with three-quarter sleeves and chemise cuffs

kerchief.desc: white linen neckerchief / partlet over the shoulders

skirt.desc: long full wool skirt, gathered at the waist

belt.desc: leather belt with a brass buckle (sits over the smock)

coif.desc: white linen cap covering the hair, framing the face

hat_wide.desc: wide-brimmed felt hat with a low crown and a band

hat_pilgrim.desc: pilgrim's hat: low round crown, wide brim pinned up at the front, a scallop shell

cap_flat.desc: soft floppy woollen bonnet that sits on the head and droops to one side

morion.desc: Spanish cabasset helmet: tall pear-shaped bowl, narrow brim, little stalk

beguine_veil.desc: beguine headdress: white wimple closed round the face and under the chin, white veil to the shoulder blades

huik.desc: the huik: long black hooded mantle from the head to below the knees, with the tuit on top

habit.desc: long religious habit to the ankles with wide sleeves (Capuchin brown / beguine black)

rope_belt.desc: knotted cord belt with hanging ends (sits over the habit)

capuche.desc: Capuchin hood (down, long point) on a short shoulder cape

pelerine.desc: pilgrim's short shoulder cape, open at the front, with two scallop shells

buff_coat.desc: soldier's sleeveless buff-leather coat to mid-thigh, worn over the doublet

sash.desc: the Spanish army's red field sash, right shoulder to left hip, knotted

hair_long.desc: shoulder-length hair with a centre parting (1650 fashion)

hair_thin.desc: thin grey hair: bald crown, fringe round the sides and back

hair_child.desc: boy's bowl-cut hair with a straight fringe

hair_bun.desc: hair parted in the middle and pulled back into a bun

beard_pointed.desc: pointed chin beard and upturned moustache (1650 fashion)

beard_full.desc: full rounded spade beard with moustache (older men)

skullcap.desc: small black skullcap (zucchetto) on the crown; wear it with hair_thin or hair_crop

bands.desc: clerical white collar with two short tabs at the throat (over the habit / cassock)

plume.desc: ostrich feather curling back from the band of the wide hat

bandolier.desc: musketeer's leather bandolier, left shoulder to right hip, with wooden powder charges

clipNotes: one shared set keyed on rig.man; stride = metres covered per loop on the man body (1.70 m); scale the pelvis translation track by bodies[b].pelvisScale for other bodies
faceMorphNotes: morph targets of these names, in this order, on every body mesh and on the pieces marked morphs:true; drive them together with the same weights
skinToneNotes: multiply into the base colour of body meshes where COLOR_0.r = 1 (skin; 0 on lips and eyes)
